headline: StepFun's step-5-preview vaults to #2 with an all-time record 9.7% token share
summary: StepFun's step-5-preview hit an all-time-high 9.7% token share and climbed eight spots to #2, while DeepSeek still holds the top with 26.4%. Three models entered at the bottom of the board as three others dropped off.
highlights: stepfun/step-5-preview-20261008 set an all-time token share record of 9.7% and rose 8 places to #2.
StepFun's provider share is up 7.1% on the day.
DeepSeek remains the leader at 26.4% of tokens, though it is down 2.4% over the day.
DeepSeek, Zhipu AI and StepFun together hold 46.4% of tokens.
openai/gpt-6.1-sol-20260929 set its own all-time record at 1.7% and moved up 4 places to #14.
New entrants: qwen/qwen3.7-flash-20260727 (#49), anthropic/claude-4.6-sonnet-20260217 (#50), and qwen/qwen3.8-flash-20260826 (#51).
